identity.provider_title_literal: Durga Saptashati With Durga Pradipa Commentary Edited By Brajavallabha Sharma Sanskrit Devi Mahatmya Pothi Illustrated Mumbai 1919 Mumbai Vaibhava Press Jagannath Bhattarai Collection
identity.normalized_scope: A historical Sanskrit Durgasaptashatipradipa and kamya-prayoga ritual-commentary/manual witness associated with recitation of the Durga Saptashati; it is not a continuous complete thirteen-chapter Devi Mahatmya main-text edition.

colophon.normalized_reading: Hariprasada's son Vrajavallabha Sharma caused the book to be printed at the Mumbai Vaibhava printing press; Saka 1841 / Vikram Samvat 1976 (1919 CE).
colophon.role_boundary: Vrajavallabha Sharma is bound to the historical printing/editorial production evidenced by the colophon. The carrier does not justify representing the Jagannath Bhattarai Collection as author or Vrajavallabha Sharma as author of the ancient Devi Mahatmya.

observed_components: asana, purification, pranapratistha, matrka-nyasa, lamp and yantra worship

external_recitation_instruction.significance: The manual instructs the practitioner to recite the Saptashati at this point rather than supplying a continuous complete main text in the carrier.

structure.decision_basis: The carrier's title leaves, contents, ritual sequence, page-70 instruction to recite the Saptashati, and terminal material establish a bounded ritual-commentary manual. They do not establish the complete 700-verse main text despite the provider title and terminal formula.

historical_rights_notice.observation: The 1919 imprint records then-current registration/rights language referring to the 1867 regulation.
historical_rights_notice.treatment: Historical evidence only; it is not silently converted into a present-day rights conclusion.

rights.reason_for_nonpromotion: The carrier is not the complete main-text object sought for the Durga hero lane, and the historical edition's underlying rights have not been separately adjudicated.
